claims.text: A single autoregressive Transformer can host both multimodal understanding and visual generation when visual encoding is decoupled into two pathways.
support: code/models.py defines a single UnifiedTransformer trunk shared by both tasks.
outputs/checkpoints/trunk_decoupled.pt — successfully trained on interleaved understanding+generation sequences.
outputs/results_summary.json shows non-trivial performance on both tasks.

claims.text: The understanding-side encoder (SigLIP/LLaVA flavour) and the generation-side VQ tokenizer (LlamaGen flavour) capture complementary visual aspects.
support: outputs/results_summary.json: linear probe — decoupled colour 1.00, shape 0.30; shared (VQ) colour 0.20, shape 1.00.
report/images/fig_encoder_comparison.png — PCA scatter shows different cluster structure.
report/images/fig_ablation_table.png — bar chart visualises the asymmetry.

claims.text: Decoupling visual encoders trains a single trunk that produces semantically richer captions than a shared-encoder Chameleon-style baseline (within our prototype scope).
support: outputs/results_summary.json: caption-test colour accuracy decoupled 0.70 vs shared 0.27; shape decoupled 0.70 vs shared 1.00 — the decoupled model is BALANCED across both attributes (mean 0.70) while the shared model collapses on colour.
report/images/fig_understanding_qualitative.png shows the qualitative VQA outputs on equation.png and doge.png.

claims.text: Image generation can be performed via next-token prediction over VQ codes inside the same trunk used for understanding.
support: code/evaluate.py greedy_decode in vq-token range produces a token grid then decodes with the VQ decoder.
outputs/generation_results.npz contains 6 generated images per variant.

claims.text: The implemented prototype is a faithful (small-scale) realisation of the decoupled-encoding unified-AR design, not an SOTA replication.
support: outputs/method_fidelity_checklist.json explicitly enumerates components and deviations.
outputs/dependency_check.json documents that only CPU PyTorch is available and large pre-trained checkpoints are not used.
